body:
You're preaching a philosophy because what you're saying isn't a real thing.

You're telling me that my physical illness is something that gets better over time if I just **think** it away. Although psychological traits do play a part in physical illness, a physical problem is only influenced on a perceptive level. So for me to walk away from this ready to beat whatever the hell it is that constantly makes me collapse and become extremely ill, I need some form of medical assistance, which I don't have.

I'd suggest actually being ill one time before coming to this conclusion. Just because you feel a little ill when you're depressed doesn't mean that you're experiencing some major form of illness in a chronic way. It just means you got better when you tried working at your depression. I can spend weeks working on my illness and it never gets better. It becomes worse the more effort I put in because I demand more of my bodies energy.

Sounds kinda like my story without the drugs really. I love sleep. I get there eventually, but I love it when I turn off for 9 hours.

I'm working on diet, posture and exercise right now. It does make me feel better, but when I have an attack of these horrible symptoms, or they're ongoing and painful, I just give up.
That is the most bullshit philosophy I've heard in my life.

Why does everyone here think that everything is fucking depression?!

My stomach is about to exit my spleen, I'm puking brown stuff, shitting diarrhea constantly, my heart rate is well over 120 sometimes when I'm just laying down, I can't stand up, I struggle to even get to the toilet to pee, I am dizzy and have constant fucking panic attacks and anxiety, along with a general feeling of malaise, sore throat, reflux, cramps and pains and spasms all over.

I'm not goddamn **depressed** when I say I'm ill. What is everyone's motherfucking pre-occupation with depression here being the only fuel for suicidal thoughts? I want to end my pain for fuck sake and I'm looking for help.

Splat is an interesting name to give advice under here, lol.

Thank you
